Triage (unified triage seat): `pm:queue`, type `Bug`. Concrete defect with named landing site and repro — the spec-canonical `field` spelling survives every metadata-aware read (`columnIdentity` is canonical-first) and then dies at the data-table adapter's `accessorKey: col.accessorKey || col.name`, the one read site objectui#3104's 22-site convergence never folded in. Silent blank-cell failure = the objectui#3951 shape one spelling over.

Dispatch notes: of the card's two suggested directions, the second (have `RelatedList.normalizeColumn` write the resolved identity into `accessorKey` before handing entries to the table) respects the boundary `column-identity.ts` deliberately drew (`TABLE_ADAPTER_COLUMN_KEY` — keep vocabulary resolution out of the table library adapter); treat that as the PM-suggested route, measurement wins. Pin both directions' invariant: an object entry keyed `field` renders cells, and the legacy `name` key keeps working. Adjacent in-flight: objectstack#9227 (spec side, `pm:dispatched`) narrowed the framework authoring surface away from this seam — no file overlap expected in this repo, but note the sibling in the claim's serial-constraints line. Size/model suggestion: S–M / opus.

采分诊席 dispatch notes 的口径:**方向 2 为 PM 建议路线**(`RelatedList.normalizeColumn` 把 `columnIdentity()` 解析出的身份写进 `accessorKey` 再交给 table)—— 它守住 `column-identity.ts` 有意画下的边界(`TABLE_ADAPTER_COLUMN_KEY`,词表解析不进 table 适配器);**实测优先**,若前提复测显示方向 2 有结构障碍,停下报告。双方向共同不变量入钉:`{ field: 'status', label }` 对象条目渲染出真实单元格,legacy `name` 键继续工作。

序列约束:邻仓 objectstack#9227(spec 侧收窄 `Field.relatedListColumns` 为字符串)在飞,预期本仓无文件重叠 —— 开工时复核该卡状态,若其结论影响本卡半径,如实报告。文件面:`packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`(+ 测试 + changeset),与在飞席位(plugin-grid src/index.tsx、plugin-view.mdx、plugin-form README)不相交。
